verdict.rationale: Fivetran provides some automation primitives — scheduled/automatic connector syncs, orchestrated transformations, and a documented 'Fivetran Alerts' feature — but there's no evidence of user-definable event-condition-action rules (e.g., webhooks firing custom actions on data events) that would satisfy an AI-native automation story. missing for 10: documented rule/trigger definition UI or API, event-based webhook/action framework, examples of custom conditional automations beyond scheduled syncs and generic alerts.
